description: The reason codes a retry hint can carry (C29.4, C37, C39.2, C51.2): the reasons GOVERNMENT_ID_CHECK_REASONS, SELFIE_CHECK_REASONS and PHASE1_CHECK_REASONS list for user_behavior checks, less the shared reasons only a not_applicable result carries, and the Phase 5 user-behaviour failure reasons (PHASE5_RETRY_HINT_REASONS, frozen in Workflow 5A Stage 1a). The web flow (English and Spanish) and the Android SDK have a message for each. apps/flow/src/i18n/retry-reasons.test.ts keeps this list equal to the contracts, and the Android SDK's MessagesTest reads it. Clients still fall back to a generic message for a reason a newer server adds.
